title: When a Few Misfits Trigger Digital Adoption Cascades: Network Reach, Threshold Heterogeneity, and Performance-Conditioned Complex Contagion in an Agent-Based Model of Firms
abstract: arXiv:2609.30269v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Why does a superior technology sometimes spread and sometimes stall, even when its expected returns are much higher? We develop an agent-based model in which firms adopt a digital technology by imitating successful neighbours through a fast-and-frugal heuristic. We compare frequency-based imitation, where firms follow the local majority, with performance-conditioned imitation, where they follow better-performing neighbours. We define a cascade as high final adoption reached through rapid, accelerating takeoff rather than slow accumulation.   In the calibrated regime, four results emerge. First, dynamic cascades arise under performance-conditioned imitation, but not under an exogenous adoption hazard or frequency-based imitation. Second, on degree-controlled networks, adoption tips once the network provides sufficient reach, at a small-world rewiring threshold near 0.41, with a 95 percent bootstrap confidence interval of 0.39 to 0.43. translated_title: 当少数“异类”引发数字采纳级联：企业主体模型中的网络可达性、阈值异质性与绩效条件化复杂传染
translated_abstract: 为什么一项更优越的技术有时能够广泛传播，有时却停滞不前，即使其预期回报要高得多？我们开发了一个基于主体（agent-based）的模型，其中企业通过一种快速节俭的启发式规则，模仿成功的邻居来采纳数字技术。我们比较了基于频率的模仿（企业跟随本地多数）与绩效条件化的模仿（企业跟随绩效更优的邻居）。我们将级联定义为通过快速、加速的起飞而非缓慢累积达到的高最终采纳率。在校准情境下，出现了四个结果：第一，动态级联仅在绩效条件化模仿下出现，而在外生采纳风险或基于频率的模仿下不会出现；第二，在度受控网络上，一旦网络提供足够的可达性，采纳便会发生翻转，小世界重连阈值约为0.41，其95%自助法置信区间为0.39至0.43。第……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究构建了企业数字技术采纳的基于主体模型，发现只有当企业采用绩效条件化模仿且网络提供足够可达性（小世界重连阈值约0.41）时，少数异类企业才能触发快速加速的数字采纳级联，而基于频率的模仿和外生采纳风险均无法产生级联。
en_tdlr: In an agent-based model of firms, a few misfit firms trigger rapid, accelerating digital adoption cascades only when imitation is performance-conditioned and network reach exceeds a small-world rewiring threshold of about 0.41, whereas frequency-based imitation and exogenous adoption hazard fail to produce cascades.
